entries.2dccc3d403ff9d15: Since fiscal 2022, it has been carrying out its 12th medium-term management plan; taking into account changes in the business environment and performance trends, it extended the final year by 2 years and revised the plan. It states that it is pursuing business expansion centered on the Fine Chemicals Business, reform of its business portfolio, management with an awareness of capital efficiency, strengthened IR activities, and reduction of strategic shareholdings, among other measures. In the Iron-Based Business, it completed the transfer of manufacturing of carrier products to Kanto Denka Finetech Co., Ltd. in fiscal 2025, and states that it will concentrate the management resources of its existing manufacturing sites on the Fine Chemicals Business. It also states that it will complete, as planned, the lithium-ion secondary battery recycling plant whose construction it has decided on, contributing to the realization of a recycling-oriented society. The plan's target figures are forward-looking matters, so they are not transcribed here.
